description: Source code for a Flask application class 'App' implementing a WSGI app with routing, templating, configuration, and error handling.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main Flask application class implementing WSGI app, routing, templating, configuration, error handling, and extension management.

methods.name: _make_timedelta
methods.description: Converts an int or timedelta to timedelta, or returns None if input is None.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Flask App with configuration, routing, templating, and extensions.

methods.name: _check_setup_finished
methods.description: Ensures setup methods are not called after the first request has been handled.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Cached property returning the application name, guessed from __main__ or import name.

methods.name: logger
methods.description: Cached property returning the application's logger.

methods.name: create_jinja_environment
methods.description: Abstract method to create Jinja environment, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: make_config
methods.description: Creates the configuration object for the app, considering instance relative path.

methods.name: make_aborter
methods.description: Creates the aborter object used for handling HTTP errors.

methods.name: auto_find_instance_path
methods.description: Locates the instance path if not provided, based on package location.

methods.name: create_global_jinja_loader
methods.description: Creates the loader for Jinja templates, dispatching between app and blueprints.

methods.name: select_jinja_autoescape
methods.description: Determines if autoescaping should be enabled for a given template filename.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Property indicating whether debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: register_blueprint
methods.description: Registers a Flask Blueprint with the application.

methods.name: iter_blueprints
methods.description: Iterates over registered blueprints.

methods.name: add_url_rule
methods.description: Adds a URL rule to the application's routing map.

methods.name: template_filter
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom Jinja filter.

methods.name: add_template_filter
methods.description: Registers a function as a custom Jinja filter.

methods.name: template_test
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom Jinja test.

methods.name: add_template_test
methods.description: Registers a function as a custom Jinja test.

methods.name: template_global
methods.description: Decorator to register a global function in Jinja templates.

methods.name: add_template_global
methods.description: Registers a function as a global in Jinja environment.

methods.name: teardown_appcontext
methods.description: Registers a function to be called when app context is torn down.

methods.name: shell_context_processor
methods.description: Registers a shell context processor function.

methods.name: _find_error_handler
methods.description: Finds a registered error handler for an exception.

methods.name: trap_http_exception
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP exception should be trapped for debugging.

methods.name: should_ignore_error
methods.description: Determines if an error should be ignored during teardown.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a redirect response object.

methods.name: inject_url_defaults
methods.description: Injects URL default values into the URL building parameters.

methods.name: handle_url_build_error
methods.description: Handles errors during URL building, possibly returning a fallback URL.
